sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा करुणं वाक्यं क्रोधो मामभ्यवर्तत ।उत्तरं च मया दृष्टं कार्यशेषमनन्तरम् ।। ५.५८.१०७ ।।।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā karuṇaṁ vākyaṁ krodho māmabhyavartata ।uttaraṁ ca mayā dṛṣṭaṁ kāryaśeṣamanantaram ।। 5.58.107 ।।।।

translations.english: "When I heard her pathetic appeal, I was overtaken by anger. I perceived the task left over for me to do.
